newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: SHARES IN CZECH KOMERCNI REBOUND.
newsitem.headline: SHARES IN CZECH KOMERCNI REBOUND.

text.p: Shares in the Prague bourse's most heavily capitalised banking issue, Komercni Banka.s., rebounded strongly on Wednesday but dealers said it was far too early to say whether a sustained uptrend was likely.
Close to mid-session during continuous trading, Komercni was up 78 crowns, 3.5 percent, to 2,300 but the share remains 11.8 percent below its price of just one month ago.
"I would say we should wait a couple of days to see if the trend will continue...I wouldn't get optimistic just because of today," said Petr Opocensky of Citicorp Securities.
Opocensky said that volume in Komercni was starting to pick up and that he had seen a 10,000 share block trade completed at 2,300 on the over-the-counter (OTC) market.
